name: Warden armor
notes: Origin at the neck base, face +Z, wearer's left +X. Parts helmet, chest, back, shoulderL, shoulderR, gauntletL, gauntletR (pivots at neck base, sternum, between shoulder blades, shoulder joints, elbows; forearm along -Y). Joints visor, shield, energy, jump 0...1; followers visorGlow, shieldRim, blade, jumpFlame switch option at 0.05.
parts: domed helmet with gold mirror visor in a raised frame, chin guard, cheek plates, ridge
layered pectoral, clavicle and abdomen plates over a black undersuit
domed pauldrons with three hanging lames
vambraces with elbow cops, gloves and knuckle plates
forearm energy-blade emitter with plasma blade on the right gauntlet
shield-rim emitter bracket with emissive rim on the left gauntlet
twin-pod jump pack with bell nozzles and flames
style: Olive green powered supersoldier armour, painted alloy plates with chamfered edges, panel seams and rivets, gold mirror visor, cyan energy emitters.
summary: Warden Mk VI armour kit: olive plated helmet with gold mirror visor, layered chest and shoulder plates, forearm energy blade, shield rim emitter and twin-pod jump pack.
